candidates.name: IR-stratified selection of cardiorenal drugs (eGDR as effect modifier)
candidates.patient_group: Adults with type 2 diabetes and CKD (finerenone), heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved EF (finerenone), and T2D with acute minor stroke or TIA (liraglutide)
candidates.measure: eGDR (waist, hypertension, HbA1c) in C177 and C185; baseline insulin-resistance index in C131 (index type not confirmed in the excerpt)
candidates.measure_type: non-insulin surrogate (eGDR); no insulin or C-peptide assay
candidates.decision: Whether a patient with a high IR index should preferentially get finerenone or a GLP-1 receptor agonist, or be expected to benefit more
candidates.evidence: Three post hoc subgroup analyses of RCTs (a finerenone CKD trial pool, FINEARTS-HF, LAMP). Only abstract or intro excerpts were seen; effect-modification direction and interaction p-values not verified.
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records. The CKM guideline (C189) mentions insulin resistance only as mechanism in the lines checked.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 13 is pioglitazone selection by HOMA-IR (IRIS entry criterion). Row 17 is generic prediction. These are drug-benefit modification by an IR index for other drugs and diseases.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Tier D: post hoc subgroups, no prospective test-and-treat trial, and eGDR needs no insulin assay.
candidates.needed: Pre-specified interaction in an RCT or a trial that randomises by IR index; replication across trials; a guideline statement.

candidates.name: Early-pregnancy TyG to predict hypertensive disorders and adverse pregnancy outcomes
candidates.decision: Which women to flag for closer surveillance or early GDM testing
candidates.evidence: One systematic review and meta-analysis (C188) of associations with GDM, HDP and adverse outcomes; a prospective first-trimester cohort (C331, intro only seen). Effect sizes and heterogeneity not read.
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records (ADA 2026 section 15, C187, was listed but nothing on TyG was seen).
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 35(b) covers first-trimester HOMA-IR for GDM only. This adds a surrogate and other outcomes (HDP, adverse outcomes).
candidates.first_pass_viability: Tier D: association-level, no intervention shown to change outcomes.
candidates.needed: Prospective validation with calibration and added value over BMI and age; a trial showing early action improves outcomes.

candidates.name: Pre-operative prediction of post-bariatric hypoglycaemia
candidates.patient_group: Adults before or after bariatric surgery
candidates.measure: Candidate predictors in C315 include pre-operative insulin use and glucose variables; no insulin or C-peptide assay confirmed
candidates.decision: Counselling and early post-operative monitoring for hypoglycaemia
candidates.evidence: One multicentre retrospective cohort (C315); only introduction and keywords seen. The text interprets pre-operative insulin use as partly preserved beta-cell function. C318, C329, C333 are prevalence, case-series or title-only papers.
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 5 is diagnosis of hypoglycaemia after surgery. This is risk prediction before symptoms.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Tier D: retrospective, predictors not insulin or C-peptide measures as far as seen.
candidates.needed: Prospective cohort testing a post-load insulin or C-peptide response as predictor, with external validation.

candidates.name: Fasting C-peptide for forecasting beta-cell depletion in established type 1 diabetes
candidates.patient_group: People with T1D (acute-onset, fulminant, slowly progressive subtypes), Japanese cohort
candidates.measure: Fasting serum C-peptide, annual, up to 14 years (C306); GADA titre as predictor of insulin dependence in SPIDDM (C285, C-peptide or insulin dependence is the outcome)
candidates.decision: Anticipate time to insulin depletion; choose follow-up intensity and counselling
candidates.evidence: One prospective longitudinal cohort (C306) with fast and slow progressor groups, C-peptide as outcome; one cut-off study (C285). Decision link is indirect; no change in care shown.
candidates.guideline_mention: Japanese SPIDDM criteria (rows 46 and 47) use a fasting C-peptide threshold for classification only.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 47 uses C-peptide to confirm progression, not to forecast it. Row 8 is trial endpoints.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Tier D: single national cohort, descriptive prognosis, no action tied to it.
candidates.needed: Validation outside Japan and evidence that the forecast changes treatment or monitoring.

refinements.missing_piece: Guideline-level confirmation and clinical-outcome follow-up for MMTT-selected stage 3 T1D
refinements.note: C281 (NEJM, PROTECT) and C330 (per-protocol analysis; entry peak stimulated C-peptide 0.2 nmol/L; week-78 benefit, lower insulin dose, higher time in range) add citations to row 29. C286 (Pediatric Endocrine Society statement) was only partly read; I did not confirm that it recommends a C-peptide test for eligibility.

refinements.missing_piece: Accuracy data for post-load tests in insulinoma versus reactive hypoglycaemia
refinements.note: C323 (5-h OGTT cohort) reports glucose curves separate insulinoma from reactive hypoglycaemia better than insulin or C-peptide, and a fasting insulin-to-glucose ratio about 4 times higher in insulinoma. C288 is a systematic review of OGTT insulin and C-peptide ratios for insulinoma. Both bear on rows 23 and 48 and may weaken the insulin component of row 48.

refinements.missing_piece: Assay-specific analogue detection, the stated path to viability
refinements.note: C181 compares Atellica and LC-MS/MS analogue cross-reactivity; C292 is a case where a routine insulin assay missed lispro; C291 shows insulin-antibody interference across three immunoassays (also row 20); C107 and C123 cover insulin and C-peptide measurement standardisation.

refinements.missing_piece: Assay harmonisation, pre-analytics and non-European thresholds for C-peptide
refinements.note: C298 and C312 call for C-peptide standardisation; C334 is title only (commutability); C309 reports EDTA tubes and 24-h room storage are suitable (low-resource use); C312 says thresholds were derived in white European adults. C283 (SEARCH, n=2,966) shows clinical models predict retained fasting C-peptide >=0.75 ng/mL in youth with AUC 0.95-0.98, which bears on rows 33 and 31.

C299 (polygenic scores, British Pakistanis and Bangladeshis) notes misclassification when C-peptide and antibodies are unavailable. C282 (meta-analysis: ketosis-prone T2D about one third of new-onset ketosis) is a citation for row 32.

C105 found HOMA-IR and HOMA-beta did not materially improve diabetes prediction. C114 reports TyG improves CV risk prediction beyond traditional factors; C126 and C135 re-test TyG reclassification; C142 reports divergent TyG and HOMA-IR associations with mortality. C176 (PREVENT) has no insulin measure.

refinements.missing_piece: Long-term islet graft function and CGM after TPIAT
refinements.note: C301 (more than 500 TPIAT patients, title only) and C326 (islet function and CGM) add to rows 27 and 10. C102 and C132 use OGTT to compare pancreatectomy types; these are outcome measures.

refinements.missing_piece: Registry data for severe IR and type B IR
refinements.note: French and European lipodystrophy registries and a type B IR case review; no new decision beyond row 12.

refinements.missing_piece: Adult versus child performance of metabolic risk scores
refinements.note: C311 (TrialNet, about 235,000 screened relatives) compares progression and metabolic risk scores in adults and children; adults at stage 2 progress like children (78% at 5 years).

notes: Scanned the full digest of 110 articles (about 40 are tied to existing rows). Many entries are title only or intro excerpts, so no numbers beyond those visible in abstracts are given. Greps of C302 and C325 (OPTN pancreas reports) found no C-peptide or insulin text, so a pancreas-transplant candidacy use was not supported in the corpus. C189 (2026 CKM guideline) and C180 (alpelisib consensus) mention insulin resistance only as mechanism in the lines checked. Pure assay and standardisation papers were treated as refinements, not uses. C183 (insulin and IGF with breast cancer risk) is title only and looks like epidemiology; not listed. Used 7 tool calls in total, one of which failed.
